create_BulletMenu: create a BulletMenu with a prompt string and a list of choices for interactive CLI selection
run_BulletMenu: run a BulletMenu instance to display an interactive selection menu and return the chosen index
move_up_BulletMenu: move the BulletMenu cursor up one position in the choice list
move_down_BulletMenu: move the BulletMenu cursor down one position in the choice list
select_row_BulletMenu: select a specific row in the BulletMenu by pressing a number key
